test_case_title: Field Test: Two physical UAVs avoid head on collision
test_case_steps: Preconditions: Dronology is running; the GCS is running and registered; predefined routes exist that would put two UAVs on a head-on collision course. Power up and activate two UAVs, then assign the collision-course routes.
expected_behavior: When the UAVs get within STOPDEAD distance, both stop and hover; no collision occurs.

test_case_title: Voltmeter tests battery level
test_case_steps: Repeat the acceptance test using 5 batteries with 5 periodic tests per battery, separated by 3–4 minutes of flying time. After landing, record Dronology's remaining-battery percentage, retrieve the manufacturer's battery information, measure voltage with an external checker, compute the expected percentage, and compare the values.
expected_behavior: The delta between the Dronology-reported battery percentage and the computed percentage is <= 5%.

test_case_title: Test collision free flight to first waypoints
test_case_steps: Create three mission plans with at least 3 UAVs per plan. Deliberately place UAVs so their routes intersect while travelling to the first waypoints. Execute the mission.
expected_behavior: The UAVs avoid collision by ascending to unique travel altitudes and then descending to the altitude of their first waypoint.

test_case_title: Flights that are tested in the simulator without collision are safe with Physical Drones
test_case_steps: Preconditions: a flight route exists; a physical UAV and simulator are ready. Assign the route to the physical UAV, fly it, and log coordinates/waypoints every 2 seconds. Repeat the same route with the simulated UAV. Compare the two logs at corresponding timestamps.
expected_behavior: Physical and simulated flight coordinates are within 1 meter of each other at corresponding timestamps.

test_case_title: Return to Launch during River Rescue uses Flight Path confined within river banks
test_case_steps: Precondition: the UAV is flying within the geofence. Select the UAV in the Dronology UI and press RTL. The UAV changes to its unique RTL altitude, flies to the longitude/latitude of its home coordinates, and descends vertically until landing.
expected_behavior: The UAV returns to its home coordinates without colliding with other UAVs in flight.

test_case_title: Return to Launch Acceptance Test
test_case_steps: Precondition: the UAV is flying within the geofence. Select the UAV in the Dronology UI and press RTL. The UAV changes to its unique RTL altitude, flies to the longitude/latitude of its home coordinates, and descends vertically until landing.
expected_behavior: The UAV returns to its home coordinates without colliding with other UAVs in flight.

test_case_title: Simulate River Rescue Scenario
test_case_steps: Preconditions: select a river region; create a JSON file describing 3 virtual UAVs on the riverbank; manually plan routes and store them in a mission plan. Import the mission plan, execute it, and log any minimum-separation-distance violations.
expected_behavior: The river-rescue mission completes without any minimum-separation-distance violations.

test_case_title: Simulation of Synchronized Takeoff
test_case_steps: SAFA V1 provides this Simulation artifact by name only; no detailed execution steps are supplied in the source.
expected_behavior: Successful synchronized-takeoff simulation; SAFA V1 does not provide a more detailed oracle for this artifact.

test_case_title: Reject waypoint below terrain safety margin
test_case_steps: Create a route containing a waypoint whose altitude is less than 3 meters above the highest terrain point in the flying zone. Attempt to validate/assign the route.
expected_behavior: The route is rejected or flagged as unsafe before execution; the below-margin waypoint must not be accepted as a safe route.

test_case_title: Accept waypoint meeting terrain safety margin
test_case_steps: Create a route whose lowest waypoint is exactly 3 meters above the highest terrain point in the flying zone and validate/assign it.
expected_behavior: The route passes the terrain-clearance rule and is accepted, assuming no other safety constraint is violated.

test_case_title: Reject invalid waypoint coordinates
test_case_steps: Submit a waypoint with invalid geographic coordinates or a coordinate outside the permitted mission area.
expected_behavior: Dronology rejects or flags the waypoint instead of issuing it to the UAV.

test_case_title: Do not issue terrain-collision waypoint
test_case_steps: Construct a waypoint that would place the UAV trajectory through known terrain and attempt to dispatch it.
expected_behavior: The unsafe waypoint is blocked or surfaced as a safety violation before the UAV is commanded to fly to it.

test_case_title: Stop both UAVs on minimum-separation violation
test_case_steps: Fly two UAVs on converging trajectories until their separation becomes smaller than MINIMUM_SEPARATION_DISTANCE.
expected_behavior: Both UAVs receive stop/hover guidance and remain separated without collision.

test_case_title: Do not stop UAVs when separation is safe
test_case_steps: Fly two UAVs on trajectories that remain above MINIMUM_SEPARATION_DISTANCE for the full maneuver.
expected_behavior: Collision-avoidance logic does not inject an emergency stop solely because two UAVs are active.

test_case_title: Detect planned route separation below eight meters
test_case_steps: Prepare two routes that come within less than 8 meters horizontally and vertically in the simulator and run the planning check.
expected_behavior: The route set is identified as violating the planning separation rule and should not be approved for physical flight.

test_case_title: Approve route set maintaining eight-meter separation
test_case_steps: Prepare routes that keep at least 8 meters separation throughout the simulated mission.
expected_behavior: The route set passes the minimum-separation planning check.

test_case_title: Log simulator separation violation
test_case_steps: Execute a simulation in which two virtual UAVs violate MINIMUM_SEPARATION_DISTANCE.
expected_behavior: The simulator log contains an explicit separation-violation entry for the event.

test_case_title: No false separation error when distance is safe
test_case_steps: Execute a simulation in which all UAV pairs stay above MINIMUM_SEPARATION_DISTANCE.
expected_behavior: No separation-violation error is recorded for the safe run.

test_case_title: Respect configured controlled-airspace altitude ceiling
test_case_steps: Configure the UAV geofence with a controlled-airspace maximum altitude and command a mission containing a waypoint above that ceiling.
expected_behavior: The UAV does not execute flight above the configured geofence ceiling; the command is rejected, constrained, or otherwise prevented.

test_case_title: Allow mission below configured geofence ceiling
test_case_steps: Configure a maximum altitude and execute a route whose waypoints all remain below it.
expected_behavior: The mission can proceed without an altitude-limit violation.

test_case_title: Preflight detects geofence above 400 ft AGL
test_case_steps: Set the geofence maximum altitude above 400 ft AGL and perform the RPIC preflight check.
expected_behavior: The configuration is flagged as noncompliant and must be corrected before flight.

test_case_title: Preflight accepts geofence at 400 ft AGL
test_case_steps: Set the geofence maximum altitude to 400 ft AGL and perform the RPIC preflight check.
expected_behavior: The altitude setting passes the FAA-limit check, subject to any stricter local restriction.

test_case_title: Raise emergency battery notification below threshold
test_case_steps: Feed a UAV battery level below the configured emergency threshold while the UAV is active.
expected_behavior: The UI activates the UAV health/emergency indication for that UAV.

test_case_title: Do not raise low-battery emergency above threshold
test_case_steps: Feed battery telemetry comfortably above the configured emergency threshold.
expected_behavior: No low-battery emergency indication is raised.

test_case_title: Block waypoint when predicted battery is insufficient
test_case_steps: Configure the UAV with battery capacity insufficient to reach the requested waypoint and then return to a safe landing location.
expected_behavior: The waypoint is not issued as a safe command; the operator/system is warned that battery capacity is insufficient.

test_case_title: Allow waypoint when predicted battery is sufficient
test_case_steps: Configure a route whose estimated energy demand is safely within the current battery capacity including return-to-safe-landing reserve.
expected_behavior: The battery-sufficiency check does not block the waypoint.

test_case_title: Prevent takeoff preparation with battery below threshold
test_case_steps: Measure the UAV battery before takeoff and set the measured value below the minimum takeoff threshold.
expected_behavior: The preflight process fails and takeoff should not be authorized.

test_case_title: Pass preflight battery check above threshold
test_case_steps: Measure the UAV battery before takeoff with a value at or above the minimum takeoff threshold.
expected_behavior: The UAV passes the battery portion of the preflight check.

test_case_title: Record UAV battery verification before flight
test_case_steps: Run the documented preflight procedure and verify the UAV battery voltage/state before arming.
expected_behavior: The preflight record shows the UAV battery was checked and met the required threshold before flight.

test_case_title: Reject preflight when handheld controller battery is low
test_case_steps: Set the hand-held controller battery below the required takeoff threshold and execute the preflight checklist.
expected_behavior: The preflight procedure fails until the controller battery is restored above the threshold.

test_case_title: Pass controller-battery preflight check
test_case_steps: Set the hand-held controller battery above the required takeoff threshold and execute the preflight checklist.
expected_behavior: The controller-battery check passes.

test_case_title: Battery percentage is visible for each active UAV
test_case_steps: Activate multiple UAVs with distinct battery levels and open the real-time flight UI.
expected_behavior: Each active UAV displays a battery percentage associated with the correct vehicle.

test_case_title: Battery display refreshes within two seconds
test_case_steps: Change incoming battery telemetry for an active UAV and measure the time until the displayed battery value updates.
expected_behavior: The displayed value refreshes within approximately 2 seconds, consistent with the traced design definition.

test_case_title: Assign unique takeoff altitudes to multiple UAVs
test_case_steps: Start coordinated takeoff with at least three UAVs from different ground positions.
expected_behavior: Each UAV ascends to a distinct coordination altitude with the required vertical spacing before lateral travel.

test_case_title: Hold UAV after ascent until synchronization point
test_case_steps: During coordinated takeoff, allow one UAV to reach its assigned ascent altitude before the others.
expected_behavior: The early UAV hovers at its assigned altitude until synchronization allows progression toward the first waypoint.

test_case_title: Transition to route execution after coordinated takeoff
test_case_steps: Complete the coordinated takeoff sequence for all UAVs and let every UAV reach its first route waypoint.
expected_behavior: The mission transitions from coordinated-takeoff behavior to normal coordinated flight and route execution.

test_case_title: Prevent mission start when calibration fails
test_case_steps: Make the UAV fail a mandatory preflight calibration check such as compass calibration and attempt to begin the mission.
expected_behavior: The UAV is not cleared for normal mission execution until calibration succeeds.

test_case_title: Allow mission start after successful calibration
test_case_steps: Complete all mandatory preflight calibration checks successfully and start the mission.
expected_behavior: Calibration does not block mission execution.

test_case_title: Issue RTL after calibration-error report
test_case_steps: While the UAV is under Dronology control, inject/report a GPS or compass calibration error from the adjacent ground-control system.
expected_behavior: The operator workflow leads to an RTL command for the affected UAV.

test_case_title: No RTL solely from normal calibration status
test_case_steps: Report normal calibration status during flight without any calibration error.
expected_behavior: The calibration-error response does not trigger RTL.

test_case_title: RTL uses unique altitude/path for one UAV
test_case_steps: Command a UAV to RTL while other UAVs are active in the area.
expected_behavior: The returning UAV uses its designated RTL altitude/path to reach home without creating a collision hazard.

test_case_title: Concurrent RTL commands remain collision-free
test_case_steps: Issue RTL to multiple active UAVs nearly simultaneously.
expected_behavior: The UAVs return along their assigned unique altitude/path strategy without midair collision.
